notes.title: Patch 1.22
notes.notes:
Fixed rewards not showing for campaign victories
Fixed Cao Hong retrieving cards from opponent's graveyard
Can now buy cards
Rates are
100 coins for common
200 for uncommon
400 rare
800 legendary
1600 mythic
Also, selling gives 10% of their values
